answer: The sable edge is published both ways, so a closed ring of 60 clones produces a signature the kernel analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. Anyone must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the summit settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 5 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
